Theme

turris, turris f.

noun, third declension

The tower, as the piece is carved.

Other words

  • rochus, rochī m.

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 52

    Traupman’s other word, the medieval name (M-O roccus); he gives adroccāre for “castle”.

  • prōpugnāculum, prōpugnāculī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. chesspieces3: rook, castle, from Vida

    Vida’s word in his chess poem (1527): classically a bulwark or tower (Verg., Cic.).

  • adroccāre
